verdict.rationale: Lithic is a hosted card-issuing API platform. Self-hosting is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hostable, on-prem, or open-source deployment of the core product. The docs describe hosted APIs, a sandbox environment, an MCP server and webhooks, none of which amount to self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
